cases.name: Jeanette Salyer
cases.about: Her obituary said Jeanette was a loving mother, grandmother, and friend to all she met. She loved big family gatherings where she could cook big meals and treats for her family and friends. Jeanette was a retired Union Carbide Lab Supervisor where she worked for many years.
